items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: That’s where Saul Williams did his first poem and that’s where Erykah used to go.

ctx.x: Spoken word. And spoken word goes right with jazz and that whole thing. There was all that combined. That scene actually happened a block from my house where I used to live a few years ago, in Brooklyn, at the spot called Brooklyn Moon actually. That’s where Saul Williams did his first poem and that’s where Erykah used to go.
Now you said there was two waves, so that was one?
